children.text: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Set automatically by Cloudflare on any domain protected by their network. It detects and manages automated bot traffic to protect the site from malicious requests. The data it contains is encrypted and can only be read by Cloudflare.
Cloudflare rate limiting cookie set on ZoomInfo's domain. Distinguishes individual users who share the same IP address to enforce rate limiting.
Anti-abuse cookie. Ensures requests within a browsing session are made by the user and not by other sites. Used by Google to detect spam and fraud in ad interactions.
Stores user's consent preferences. Necessary for enforcing data subject rights.
Google account security cookie. Contains digitally signed and encrypted records of the user's Google Account ID and sign-in time to prevent CSRF attacks.
Stores user’s opt-out choice. Prevents tracking. Supports privacy by design.
Used by cookie compliance tools to remember user's cookie consent settings.
Records the domain the user originally visited (e.g. bigcommerce.com). Used to pre-fill Marketo forms with the correct source URL so leads are attributed to the right site.
Google account session cookie. Contains digitally signed and encrypted records of the user's Google Account ID and most recent sign-in time.
Google account security cookie. Used to protect user data from unauthorized access.
*These trackers are set by Google only for users who are logged in to their Google account.

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
Used by Google for A/B testing and feature rollout bucketing across Google services.
BigCommerce cookie used for A/B testing and Amplitude Experimentation.
Stores anonymous ID, user ID, Amplitude Experiments, Segment traits.
LinkedIn data center routing cookie. Used to facilitate data centre selection and improve page load performance.
Used by Google to prevent the browser from sending this cookie along with cross-site requests. Mitigates CSRF attacks on Google Search.

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
Stores user preferences such as preferred language and SafeSearch settings on Google Search and YouTube.
Temporary user ID used by Segment to track anonymous (unknown) users.
Records the timestamp of the last time the Amplitude session replay tool accessed the session, used to manage session continuity.
Internal analytics tracking identifier used to measure usage and engagement across BigCommerce properties.
Session-scoped internal analytics identifier used to group events within a browsing session.
Temporary user identifier  used by Segment to identify anonymous (unknown) users in order to correlate events across systems and downstream tools.

Registers the website's speed and performance metrics. This function can be used in context with statistics and load-balancing. It helps in monitoring the performance of the website and ensuring optimal user experience.

These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
Google account session cookie. Contains digitally signed and encrypted records of the user's Google Account ID and sign-in time.
Google account security cookie. Used to identify trusted web traffic for signed-in users.
Google account session timestamp cookie. Used alongside other SID cookies for account authentication.
Google account API access cookie used in cross-site contexts for signed-in users.
Google account session cookie for cross-site contexts. Contains encrypted Google Account ID.
Google account security cookie for cross-site contexts.
Google account session timestamp for cross-site contexts.
Facebook Pixel cookie. Set on our domain by the Meta Pixel when it loads. Tracks visits across websites to deliver Facebook ad campaigns and measure their effectiveness.
Google Ads conversion linker cookie. Stores and tracks ad click information to measure conversions from Google Ads campaigns.
This is a unique identifier for the visitor’s session on the website and is used to correlate page views and activities to a single browsing session on the website.

This is a unique identifier for the visitor that is specific to the website, and will remain unique for the duration of the visitor’s lifecycle on the site to help recognize returning users and maintain session continuity.
Tracks visitor behaviour across sessions to serve targeted B2B advertising and account-based marketing.
Marketo tracking cookie. Links visitor behaviour on our site to Marketo lead records for profiling, lead nurturing, and marketing automation.
(Universal Event Tracking) session cookie. Used by Bing Ads to track conversions and determine which ads to show based on user activity.
(Universal Event Tracking) Microsoft pseudoanonymized visitor ID to personalise ads and track return visits.
Registers user behavior and navigation on the website and interaction with active campaigns for B2B ad targeting and retargeting.
Google account API session cookie. Used to display personalized advertisements on Google sites based on recent searches.
LinkedIn browser identifier cookie. Used to identify the browser for LinkedIn advertising and analytics features.
Identifies the company a visitor belongs to for B2B account-based marketing.
Used to identify the browser for advertising and analytics features.
Google DoubleClick cookie used for personalized ad delivery and measurement.
LinkedIn consent cookie. Stores the user's consent state for LinkedIn cookies.
Identifier for targeting across Microsoft advertising services.
Google account API session cookie. Used for personalized advertising and YouTube functionality for signed-in users.
Google account session cookie. Used alongside HSID and APISID for YouTube and Google services personalization.
*These trackers are set by Google only for users who are logged in to their Google account.

header.toolTip: Create and manage multiple, unique storefronts within your BigCommerce dashboard. Whether you manage multiple brands, sell across customer segments or build across different regions — streamline your operations from one single account.
Connect your offline and online business with POS integrations to Square, Vend, Clover, Heartland Retail, and more.
Connect your store to the world’s largest marketplaces to reach millions of new shoppers while managing all your orders from BigCommerce.
Reach more customers & drive conversion with Facebook Shop & Instagram Checkout.

header.content: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay

header.toolTip: With more than 70 discount options available out-of-the-box, BigCommerce offers advanced but user-friendly promotions tools — without using a third-party app.
Accept payments in over 100+ currencies and offering local payment methods through the gateway of your choice.
Give shoppers the most accurate shipping pricing available with real-time rates from UPS, USPS, FedEx, Australia Post, Royal Mail, Canada Post and more.
Help improve your SEO rankings and deliver a content-rich experience to your shoppers with a blog.

header.content: Free Sitewide HTTPs and Dedicated SSL
header.toolTip: All traffic to your site is over HTTPs and comes with a free dedicated SSL that helps improve consumer confidence, search rankings and conversion by keeping shoppers on your custom domain during checkout.
Increase checkouts and eliminate overpayment for misquotes by using the world’s most sophisticated shipping rules engine right from BigCommerce.
Segment your customers for pricing, product access and promotions to create differentiated experiences on your website.
This conversion tool automatically sends shoppers a customizable series of emails motivating them to complete their purchase.
Improve your customers’ experience by saving their shopping cart to their account, so when they switch devices, their cart is still there.
Returning customers are sent to the payment step with their billing and shipping automatically filled to save time at checkout.
Improve the shopping experience by enabling shoppers to easily and dynamically filter products.
Your custom product fields can be used as product filters in faceted search.
Give B2B customers a B2C-level experience with custom pricing at the SKU level for customer groups.
Use the industry's fastest APIs to automatically sync data from 3rd party systems (such as ERPs) seamlessly into BigCommerce.
Sell and fulfill orders in multiple retail locations, including in store pick up and curbside.
Calculated on a trailing 12-month basis.
We’re available 24/7 via chat, email, and US-based phone support for any technical issues you may have.
